name: Church Anniversary
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of steadfastness, unity, and praise in the life of the church. Nehemiah 4:6 highlights the collective effort and determination needed to build and maintain the church community, while Matthew 16:18 and Luke 6:48 affirm that the church is founded on the solid rock of Christ, ensuring its endurance against opposition. The church is also called to be a visible light to the world (Matthew 5:14) and a place of continual worship and thanksgiving, as expressed in Psalms 100:5 and 150:1.
